## Exact scope and independent judgment

This fresh M2 reassessment covers correction 1acf15f0fa13839fb68bea27633906313e87e2ff, its current registered evidence and the unchanged M2 engineering subjects originally reviewed at 75f13e09 against a582dbe1. The approved Skill/System and Delivery plan remain unchanged. Current evidence entry m2-correction-integration binds the implemented engineering surface, distinguishes old subject observations and preserved narrative, and records exact immutable-head integration proof. Previous package judgments remain baseline assessments and are not retargeted to new subjects.

The original reporter independently assessed the correction. Reviewer authored none of the engineering, archive/navigation changes, narrative transfer or proof. Prior Design/M1/M2 review activity was assessment only. No implementation, work, activity or plan state was edited by this reviewer.

## Correction and preservation assessment

All eight branch-new stage narratives are preserved inside explicit summary strings in registered evidence entries named preserved-<original stem>. An independent Python comparison read each original from 75f13e09 and verified its entire decoded UTF-8 text is an exact suffix of the corresponding stored summary; each wrapper includes its original path and matching raw-byte SHA-256. All eight redundant sidecars are absent from the corrected tree and net branch diff. Each wrapper expressly retains original scope/claims without renewing approval. Comparison also confirmed all six review files present at 75f13e09 remain byte-identical through the correction. The M2 r1 original judgment and finding origin are preserved; this separate reassessment changes only reporter disposition through its explicit operation.

This is a storage correction under RF-SR-01/03, with no new schema, selector exception, runtime format, registry or rewritten historical evidence. Original removed-note subjects remain honest historical observations; Record Format distinguishes disappeared external subjects from broken internal EntryRefs. Current reliance uses the preserved entry text and the unchanged engineering hashes, plus fresh integration proof. Removing the redundant external file therefore does not remove its evidence or silently make an old approval current. These notes are stage-owned narrative, not operational resources or required published package files.

M2 r1's full source-transfer assessment remains applicable: Skill's current metadata/role/vocabulary/population/exception rules are precise; mixed plan/boundary obligations and supersessions are retained; exact architecture common portions point to Skill; four archival snapshots preserve original bytes; all 73 navigation targets resolve; current consumers are coherent. The closed five-path archive selection continues to select skills.regression while unknown archive paths fail closed. No engineering or test changed during narrative correction, so no new test maintenance concern or implicit pilot expansion arose.

## Actual checks and limits

Reviewer performed git diff/stat/status inspection, exact primary full-subject/context reads, complete current correction-evidence inspection, Python original-text/path/hash and prior-review byte comparisons, and read the full-branch command/output. Earlier M2 archive equality and 73-link checks and semantic source assessment are reused because those bytes are unchanged. No expensive suite was redundantly rerun by this reviewer.

The inspected passing command was bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base ffb58ecb2b8879926eaa1db0784761768ffb303e --head 1acf15f0fa13839fb68bea27633906313e87e2ff --timeout 1200 --jobs 4, with log /tmp/skl-full-branch-ci3.log. Its selected lifecycle, change-record, guide, selector and other checks passed. The earlier symbolic --head HEAD invocation failed snapshot validation; ci.sh documents immutable --head <sha>, and current proof records successful exact snapshot validation. No production defect or suppressed check is inferred from this caller error.

The current proof separately reports candidate Gate B, generated drift, metadata and 133 unchanged canonical-file comparisons. Prior M1 suites and M2's 358 skill/nine guide test results remain bounded supporting evidence for unchanged subjects. Broad smoke is separately pending and is not claimed here. This milestone judgment is not fresh final whole-change review, final Verify, CI-wide readiness, publication authority or completed adoption. Route may close M2 and request the distinct final integrated assessment. No material finding remains open within this M2 review.
